title: Hearing on hunger and food insecurity in New York City
summary: The Council's Committee on General Welfare held an oversight hearing on hunger and food insecurity, examining SNAP enrollment, food pantry usage and federal funding cuts under H.R.1. It also heard bills on warming centers, a SNAP anti-fraud officer, and resolutions urging state and federal action on SNAP fraud compensation and hot food purchases. As of December 2025 more than 1.7 million New Yorkers received SNAP benefits totaling over $414 million.
